method: Each tested atmosphere is hidden in turn, the model is refitted without it, and the app is asked about that atmosphere with the refitted model (same honesty gate, same band).

query.L_mm: M1/M2: each held-out test's droplet size; M3: 10
query.options: each held-out test's own fuel (and droplet size or fuel fraction)
query.why: The tests flew in microgravity with no imposed flow, so g = 0 gives the plain model band (widening factor 1); vent speed has no effect at g = 0.

settings.group_band: mean of the per-test estimates and band edges

M1.label: P(droplet flame self-extinguishes before burnout)
M1.hit_rule: Observed share of self-extinctions with a 90% Wilson interval; hit when that interval overlaps the predicted 90% band (lenient for groups of 1-3 tests). strict_hit: the observed share itself is inside the band.

M2.label: Extinction diameter
M2.hit_rule: Hit when the median observed extinction diameter is inside the predicted 90% band; the share of single held-out diameters inside their own band is pooled as a calibration check.

M3.label: P(gas flame self-extinguishes vs flow-terminated)
M3.hit_rule: Observed share of self-extinctions with a 90% Wilson interval; hit when that interval overlaps the predicted 90% band (lenient for groups of 1-3 tests). strict_hit: the observed share itself is inside the band.

wide_check.what: Every tested atmosphere in the same 0.10-wide O2 band is hidden at once, so an atmosphere far from the rest loses its neighbours. This checks the 'no evidence' side of the gate, which the primary test (one atmosphere at a time) almost never reaches.

M1.label: P(droplet flame self-extinguishes before burnout)
M1.hit_rule: Observed share of self-extinctions with a 90% Wilson interval; hit when that interval overlaps the predicted 90% band (lenient for groups of 1-3 tests). strict_hit: the observed share itself is inside the band.

saffire_hindcast.caveat: Not discriminative: the bridge scores 7/9, but the constant rule '1 g always burns more' also scores 7/9. It checks the direction of the gravity effect, not whether the bridge can tell samples apart.
